name: Backup Verification
description: Sanity-checks the most recent backup: existence, age, integrity (manifest hash), and size-trend deviation. Surfaces anomalies via SkillResult.fail so the rest of the pipeline (alerting, dashboard) reacts.

inputs.name: maxAgeHours
inputs.description: Backup must be newer than this

inputs.name: sizeDriftPct
inputs.description: Alert if last backup deviates ±this% from rolling avg

steps.description: Identify the most recent backup file
Fail if the newest backup is older than maxAgeHours
steps.command: NEWEST=$(ls -t ${inputs.backupDir}/*.tar* 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$NEWEST" ] || { echo 'no backup files found'; exit 2; }; AGE_HRS=$(( ($(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y "$NEWEST")) / 3600 )); echo "newest=$NEWEST age_hrs=$AGE_HRS"; [ $AGE_HRS -lt ${inputs.maxAgeHours} ]

steps.description: Verify manifest checksum if a .sha256 sibling exists
steps.command: NEWEST=$(ls -t ${inputs.backupDir}/*.tar* 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -f "$NEWEST.sha256" ]; then sha256sum -c "$NEWEST.sha256"; else echo 'no sha256 sidecar; skipping integrity check'; fi

steps.description: Check the newest backup size against the rolling average of the prior 7
steps.command: cd ${inputs.backupDir} 2>/dev/null && ls -t *.tar* 2>/dev/null | head -8 | xargs -I {} stat -c '%s %n' {} | awk -v drift=${inputs.sizeDriftPct} 'NR==1{newest=$1} NR>1{tot+=$1; n++} END{ if(n==0){ print "insufficient history"; exit 0 } avg=tot/n; pct=((newest-avg)/avg)*100; printf "newest=%d avg=%d drift=%.1f%%\n", newest, avg, pct; if (pct < -drift || pct > drift) { print "DRIFT"; exit 3 } }'

steps.description: Roll up — failures upstream surface here as steps.<id>.ok=false
steps.command: echo 'Backup verification: newest=${steps.newest.ok}, age=${steps.age_check.ok}, integrity=${steps.integrity.ok}, size_trend=${steps.size_trend.ok}'
